title: Hook-partition formulae for Kadar–Yu Gram determinant polynomials
source: Benjamin Morris and Paul P. Martin, “On semisimplicity criteria and non-semisimple representation theory for the Kadar-Yu algebras”, arXiv:2512.24535 (2025). (https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24535), Conjecture 3.31.1

lanes.discovery_and_review: brauer-hook-372351-independent-review-sol62-20261118-r1 and its producer lane (ordinary proof, independent review PASS)
lanes.paper_rereview: brauer-hook-372351-manuscript-rereview-sol62-20261118-r1/REVIEW.md (PASS WITH EDITORIAL EDITS; revised copy used)

significance.root_decision: Morris-Martin Conjecture 3.31.1 gives closed formulas for the Gram determinants of the one-cup standard modules of the Kadar-Yu algebras indexed by the hook (a+1,1) and its transpose. As printed the conjecture is false: at height a = 5 and tail length 0 the determinant has degree 174 while the printed product has degree 166. The corrected formulas are proved for both families, the ordinary hook for every a >= 2 and the transposed hook for every a >= 1, for every tail length k >= 0: in (3.3.7) the exponent of the loop variable becomes (a+3)(a+2)(a-2)/6, in (3.3.10) the missing operator is a plus, and the recurrence carries the minus sign; (3.3.8) and (3.3.9) stand as printed. Credit is for the corrected uniform theorem; the literal refutation alone would be an erratum.
significance.caveat: The link between the Lean Gram matrix and the source Gram matrix is by construction, checked by an independent audit with computations from the source definitions (all 14 worked determinants of the source reproduced), not a kernel-checked theorem. Enyang-Goodman and De Visscher-Martin are unread; no new literature search in the final revision. Determinants are normalized up to a nonzero constant, as the source allows.

root_basis: Root extracted all 58 modules from the appendix into an empty directory, rebuilt and kernel-checked them (all exit 0, object hashes identical to the author build, axioms exactly the allowed three). Definition fidelity was audited by an independent Opus lane against the source with its own computations. The written proof failed a first independent review on two defects, was revised, and passed an independent re-review with exact checks of 22 Gram determinants.
